dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: The village head... do you mean some person who's in charge of everyone?

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: I don't think that describes me. I'm just a little older than the other kids. As everyone's big sister, it's my responsibility to help with day-to-day issues.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: That's right — I've gotta look after everyone.
